title: Review and export a synthetic case
scenario: Scenario: reviewed-cases / workflow-map. Fresh correction capture on d8cd2c5. Python 3.11+, a disposable home and synthetic inputs; no model call.

steps.title: Declare the cause and inspect the case boundary
steps.instruction: Open docs/map/workflow.html and choose 2. Case / reviewed export. Follow Sources to the authoritative Store guide. Select a frozen revision and feedback; supply triage category and evidence IDs, synthetic inputs and a successful or contrary counterpart.
steps.caption: Actual current workflow dialog. Evidence-bound caller triage is reported attribution, not automated diagnosis.
steps.expected: Only instruction cases qualify. Outcome cases need a referenced failed tool. Unknown is insufficient; environment/auth/grader are blocked. Routing/adherence need correction-linked evidence without a failed-tool prerequisite.

steps.title: Review exact bytes and export to a new path
steps.instruction: Run prepare, then show. Keep its triage envelope private; inspect the public payload and counterpart. Review the exact digest with both flags. Export into an existing directory using its resolved real path. Revoke the disposable grant after the check.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered summary of actual synthetic CLI results, not a terminal or live efficacy result.
steps.expected: Missing correction stays insufficient. Unreviewed, existing, parent-link, relative and private-store outputs refuse. Revoke purges private lineage; expiry disables access and prune deletes bytes. Detached synthetic exports remain. Review assertions are not automatic sanitization.
